decision: Synthetic capability demonstrated; do not change production profile.
measured_scope: One deliberately repetitive sentence-copy prompt, warm model, fixed-order independent processes, one warmup then three matched native /completion requests per profile. This is not Power/Gateway end-to-end or a representative workload benchmark.
demonstrated: Frozen runtime b10787-73bfe6cc4 actually enabled ngram-mod/map-k/map-k4v/cache with positive draft counts on qwen35 and matched output digests; parser-only support is not the evidence.
No seq_rm rejection was observed during these requests. This does not establish arbitrary recurrent-state rollback correctness.
PTQ1 weights, c32768, slot1, FAon, t8, default graph/MMQ settings and unbound CPU placement were held constant.
Fixed8 ngram-mod was faster than adaptive2-cap8 on this high-acceptance synthetic prompt.
The simple8 candidate generated zero draft tokens on this fixture, so it provides no acceleration evidence.
correctness_limits: Every observed drafted token was accepted; partial-rejection/rollback paths were not exercised.
cache_prompt=false and timings.cache_n=0 only establish no prompt/KV reuse in these requests; they do not establish that ngram history/dictionaries are reset or isolated across requests/tenants.
The warmup and repeated identical requests may train/preserve ngram state. First warmup and measured draft counts differ for mod profiles. A cold/fresh-history comparison is still required.
Startup type enablement and positive draft counts do not prove CUDA graph/kernel execution details. No nsys/ncu trace exists.
Default /props generation settings contain speculative.types=none despite actual startup and positive draft execution. Do not use that default-request field alone to reject runtime capability.
One prompt and three repeats do not establish broad quality, tail latency, context-length or concurrency safety.
next_promotion_gates: Hermetic provider/gateway behavior remains green with accurate authoritative usage and cancellation; no SSE-chunk token inference.
Prove recurrent checkpoint/rollback parity on mixed-accept/reject continuations and strict deterministic digests at relevant context lengths.
Prove or enforce per-authenticated-domain ngram/cache isolation, request cancellation state cleanup, and compatible pinned slot/profile compositions.
Run matched cold-history and warm-history representative coding/chat/tool workloads plus concurrent stress, recording wall/TTFT/decode, actual tokens, proposals/accepts, memory and errors.
Only promote after a separately specified acceptance gate and rollback plan; this bounded synthetic result is not a production target or approval.
initial_probe: p4-initial-probe/p4-results.json is superseded/inconclusive: its script used an incorrect nested props gate and sent no candidate requests. It is retained for audit, excluded from summary/performance claims.
